architecture: Observed-only two-output kernel controller blends root and articulated rotation context against the frozen V3 learned trajectory; full FK preserves lengths
baseline: linear root and local quaternion SLERP through complete ancestor hierarchy
selection: Validation position + 0.1 rotation; incumbent V3 included, compare all previous baselines and full original gates
notes: Both base and controller trained only on existing training clips; validation selects variants, observed-development loaded after saved selection.
No new assets or costs; no fresh blind confirmation.
Gate targets are bounded optimal training-label projection coefficients; these targets must never enter inference.
No-context windows keep V3 predictions. Context strength is predicted from serialized known poses and timing, never hidden motion.
training_objective: Cohort-weighted regularized regression of complete curve coefficients fitted from training labels; temporal errors are acceptance metrics, not direct regression loss terms.
experiment: Learned root/rotation context controller on top of frozen V3 articulated predictor
